findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "scan_agent_payload_security" references sensitive artifacts (private key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: [0.003000 USDC via x402] Scans untrusted agent tool outputs, prompts, or code patches for prompt-injection overrides, Unicode bidi trojans (CVE-2021-42574), lea…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: fetch_openfda_recalls · Private data: scan_agent_payload_security, fetch_sec_form_d_startup_leads, screen_ofac_sanctions, evaluate_token_risk_verdict, extract_forensic_web_markdown · Public sink: verify_b2b_email_deliverability.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: fetch_openfda_recalls · Private data: scan_agent_payload_security, fetch_sec_form_d_startup_leads, screen_ofac_sanctions, evaluate_token_risk_verdict, extract_forensic_web_markdown · Public sink: verify_b2b_email_deliverability

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
